column3: Scans current_schema() only, like the other PostgreSQL vendor rules, whereas BootUI scans all non-system schemas.

BootUI reads the HikariCP and Agroal acquisition timeouts; sharpit reads SQLAlchemy's QueuePool timeout, where None, an infinite timeout or one too large for milliseconds disables the timeout and 0 fails immediately rather than waiting indefinitely; a pool class with no acquisition timeout (NullPool, StaticPool, SingletonThreadPool) is not evaluated.
